Save Report this job Management Level G Notified is looking for individuals who love to design, code and want to build amazing products for a global market. Exciting opportunity in Bangalore, India for a Sr. Software (.Net) Engineer to work on our Public Relations platform. If you have a passion for coding, strong communication skills and a track record of developing multi-user applications then this is a great role for you. Location : This role will be based out of The Leela Office located on the 4th Floor, Airport Road, Kodihalli, Bangalore- 560008. Our expectation at this time, is that you would work from our office on Tuesdays, Wednesdays, Thursdays with flexibility to work from home on Mondays and Fridays. Day to day responsibilities of the role include, but are not limited to: Your work tasks / responsibilities Design and develop state of the art, modern, high performing, scalable web applications. Review of business requirement documentation and assisting the team in breaking down into user stories for the team backlog. Creation and maintenance of technical specifications. These user stories will have to be developed using C#.NET Web APIs, nodeJS and SQL Server as database schema by following best coding practices and writing unit tests. You will also be responsible for doing code review. Ongoing maintenance, support, and enhancements of existing systems and platforms. Active participation in the implementation, operation and troubleshooting of new cloud-based and cloud-hosted services. Active participation in building and improving our continuous integration and deployment processes (CI/CD). Participation (virtual or in person) in planning meetings for coordination between the Scrum teams. Participation in the continuous improvement of our Agile and DevOps culture and engineering best practices. Monitoring system performance and creation of highly scalable and operable systems. Independent and joint development of solutions for complex problems. Minimum Qualifications Degree in computer science or comparable qualification and 5+ years professional experience as a .NET software engineer. Expert experience writing secure APIs, microservices, reusable components, and modules. Good understanding of .NET web application development, build and deployment. Good understanding in front end technologies like JavaScript, Typescript and associated frontend frameworks such as Angular (preferred), React, Vue. Good understanding of Azure or AWS (Amazon Web Services) application development services. Good understanding of nodeJS. Relevant certificates are added plus. Collaborative working habits that accelerate the team. Very good spoken and written English. Practical experience in the application of agile methodologies (e.g., Scrum) Responsible, independent, and solution-oriented working style that is based on an overall understanding of the respective problems Preferred Qualifications Experience in developing enterprise scale, multi-user applications. Solid understanding of designing and optimizing Web APIs for large scale usage. Experience in MVC.NET web-based application development using Microsoft .NET Core, Standard and/or Framework with C# Dependency Injection Object-Relational Mapping ORM Frameworks IIS hosting SQL Server, schema creation, query optimization Experience in serverless architecture, design and development using AWS services. Nice to have experience in Apache SOLR. About Notified Notified, Your Story Begins Here We are Notified, the only technology partner dedicated to both investor relations and public relations professionals. We help our clients control and amplify the corporate narrative. Our fully integrated PR and IR platforms streamline every step from press release distribution, media targeting, and analytics to IR websites, earnings and investor events, and regulatory filings. Powered by GlobeNewswire, one of the largest and most trusted newswire distribution networks for over 30 years, we empower communicators to inform a better world. Notified is an affiliate of Equiniti Group Limited (EQ), a fintech that connects the future of capital, communications, and governance — building trust and confidence in every market we serve. Why You Will Love Working Here EQ is recognized as a Top Employer in US, UK and India! Together we offer more than a job, we offer a place to grow. Through hands-on experience, real-world projects, and access to industry-leading tools, you’ll have what you need to build a meaningful career. You’ll join a diverse, global team united by innovation, collaboration, and a shared passion for what we do. With flexible work options, competitive pay, wellness benefits, and a people-first culture, we support your success - both at work and beyond. Come and join us — let’s grow together. We are committed to equality of opportunity for all staff and applications from individuals are encouraged regardless of age, disability, sex, gender reassignment, sexual orientation, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief and marriage and civil partnerships. jobs.title: Product Engineer Intern - Unibox
jobs.description: Product Engineer Intern - Unibox Lifie AI Bengaluru, Karnataka, India 23 hours ago Over 200 applicants See who Lifie AI has hired for this role Apply Save Report this job ABOUT LIFIE AI Lifie AI helps businesses automate customer engagement across voice, chat, and outbound campaigns. Our AI agents help sales and operations teams respond to leads faster, run high-volume outreach, qualify prospects, verify data, and improve conversion without increasing headcount. Backed by angel investors and experienced enterprise technology leaders, Lifie AI has crossed $120K in ARR and is continuing to grow. We are running pilots with NASDAQ-listed enterprises and building vendor and technology partnerships with multiple enterprise platforms. We work with businesses across India, North America, and other global markets. We are now expanding our engineering team and looking for a fresher Product Engineer Intern who wants to build real product, ship fast, and learn directly from the founders. ABOUT THE ROLE We are hiring a Product Engineer Intern to build and ship features across Unibox — our CRM/inbox/campaigns product — a real, live product surface used by paying customers. This is a hybrid internship based in HSR, Bengaluru — freshers and final-year students welcome, no professional experience required. You will work across the entire stack — from React/TypeScript and TanStack Start on the frontend to Postgres and Cloudflare on the backend — while building integrations with AI, voice, telephony, payments, and other external services. You will work directly with the founders and engineering team, with real ownership of features from day one — not shadowing, not busywork. Strong performers get a full-time offer at the end of the internship, with a revised salary and equity (see Compensation & Growth below). WHAT YOU'LL DO - Build and ship features across the React/TypeScript frontend (TanStack Start) on Unibox - Work with Postgres — schema design, queries, and secure data access patterns - Build and debug backend logic in serverless/edge functions (Cloudflare Workers) - Integrate third-party APIs across voice/telephony (Twilio, Plivo), billing (Stripe), and AI (Anthropic, Groq - quick inference models) - Work across real CRM product domains — objects like companies, prospects, and deals; inbox and messaging; campaigns and outreach workflows - Write clean, typed code that follows existing patterns, and ship it through code review - Debug production issues directly alongside founders and engineers - Develop a strong understanding of how Unibox is architected end-to-end WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - Freshers and final-year students (CS or related background) welcome — no professional experience required - Solid fundamentals in JavaScript/TypeScript, React, and basic SQL/databases - Comfortable reading and navigating an existing codebase, not just building from scratch - Curious, coachable, and eager to learn how a real product is built and shipped - Strong ownership instinct — willing to dig in, ship, and iterate quickly - Personal projects, hackathons, open-source contributions, or prior internships are a plus, but not mandatory - Interest in AI, CRM, or SaaS products is a plus - Able to work hybrid out of our HSR, Bengaluru office YOU'LL DO WELL IN THIS ROLE IF - You take ownership instead of waiting for instructions - You care about code quality, not just features shipped - You debug systematically instead of guessing - You continuously test and improve your approach - You are comfortable working in a fast-moving startup environment - You want to grow into a full-time, full-stack engineering role COMPENSATION & GROWTH - Stipend: ₹15,000–₹30,000/month during the internship, based on interview performance and fit - Performance-based increase: exceptional performers can move up to ₹8 LPA CTC on conversion to a full-time role — this is not automatic, it's earned through consistent, high-quality shipped work during the internship - Stock options (ESOP): on full-time conversion, you become eligible for an ESOP grant from Lifie AI's employee option pool — standard 4-year vesting with a 1-year cliff, subject to board approval - Path: Internship → performance review → full-time Product Engineer offer with revised CTC + ESOP WHY JOIN LIFIE AI - Join an angel-backed AI startup with growing enterprise adoption - Own real product surfaces on a live, paying-customer product, not a side project - Work directly with the founders and engineering team from day one - Build and ship a CRM/AI product solving high-value problems for global businesses - Real path to a full-time role with a strong CTC, ESOP, and growth into a senior full-stack engineering role Show more Show less Seniority level Internship Employment type Full-time Job function Engineering and Information Technology Industries Software Development Referrals increase your chances of interviewing at Lifie AI by 2x See who you know
